pen: The Qur'an names the hours for glorifying Allah: the evening, the morning, the night and midday.
ken: Said as the day turns: at dusk, at dawn, and again through the hours between.
aen: From Surah Ar-Rum. The ayat set praise against the turning of the day, so that every part of it has its remembrance.
t: Bertasbih Pada Waktu Petang dan Pagi
p: Al-Quran menyebut waktu-waktu untuk bertasbih kepada Allah: petang, pagi, malam dan tengah hari.
keg: Diucapkan ketika hari bertukar: waktu senja, waktu subuh, dan pada jam-jam di antaranya.
asb: Daripada Surah Ar-Rum. Ayat ini meletakkan pujian di setiap pergantian hari, supaya setiap bahagiannya ada zikirnya.
art: Maghrib on the veranda of a kampung house. A boy in songkok and baju Melayu sits on the top step holding a tasbih, looking up at a sky turning from sunset to dusk, birds flying home, a surau minaret small in the distance between coconut palms.
tr: fasub'ḥāna l-lahi ḥīna tum'sūna waḥīna tuṣ'biḥūna walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waʿashiyyan waḥīna tuẓ'hirūna
en: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
my: (Setelah kamu mengetahui yang demikian) maka bertasbihlah kepada Allah semasa kamu berada pada waktu malam dan semasa kamu berada pada waktu subuh. Serta pujilah Allah yang berhak menerima segala puji (dari sekalian makhlukNya) di langit dan di bumi, dan juga (bertasbihlah kepadaNya serta pujilah Dia) pada waktu petang dan semasa kamu berada pada waktu zuhur.

pen: A call to the believers: remember Allah often, and glorify Him morning and evening.
ken: For the start and the close of the day, and for any moment in between.
aen: From Surah Al-Ahzab, addressed to all who believe. It asks for remembrance that is frequent, not occasional.
p: Seruan kepada orang beriman: ingatlah Allah dengan banyak, dan bertasbihlah kepadaNya pagi dan petang.
keg: Untuk permulaan dan penghujung hari, dan untuk bila-bila masa di antaranya.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-Ahzab, ditujukan kepada semua orang beriman. Ia meminta zikir yang kerap, bukan sesekali.
art: Just after Subuh. A grandfather with a white beard and kopiah sits on a wooden bench on the veranda with a tasbih, his small grandson leaning sleepily against his arm. Mist lies over the padi fields, a single lamp still lit indoors.
tr: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū l-laha dhik'ran kathīran wasabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan
en: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
my: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, (untuk bersyukur kepada Allah) ingatlah serta sebutlah nama Allah dengan ingatan serta sebutan yang sebanyak-banyaknya; Dan bertasbihlah kamu kepadaNya pada waktu pagi dan petang.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih

ten: Your Lord's Name, Morning and Evening
pen: One short command: mention the name of your Lord at the start and the end of the day.
ken: A line to keep for the morning and for the evening.
aen: From Surah Al-Insan, among its closing instructions to the Prophet, which the believers follow.
t: Sebutlah Nama Tuhanmu Pagi dan Petang
p: Satu perintah yang ringkas: sebutlah nama Tuhanmu pada permulaan dan penghujung hari.
keg: Satu baris untuk disimpan bagi waktu pagi dan petang.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-Insan, antara pesanan penutupnya kepada Nabi, yang diikuti oleh orang beriman.
art: Early morning on a kampung path. A girl in tudung and school uniform walks with her bag, lips moving softly, the sun rising behind coconut palms, mist on the road and a bicycle leaning on a fence.
en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
my: Dan sebutlah dengan lidah atau dengan hati akan nama Tuhanmu (di dalam dan di luar sembahyang), pada waktu pagi dan petang;
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih

tr: rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīrun
en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
my: Wahai Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku sangat berhajat kepada sebarang rezeki pemberian yang Engkau berikan".

ten: In Need of Whatever Good You Send
pen: Musa's dua in the shade at Madyan, alone and far from home, with nothing to eat.
ken: When you are hungry, out of work, or waiting on provision you cannot arrange yourself.
aen: From Surah Al-Qasas. Musa had fled Egypt, watered the flocks of two women who could not reach the well, then sat in the shade and asked.
t: Berhajat Kepada Kebaikan Yang Engkau Turunkan
p: Doa Musa di bawah teduhan di Madyan, seorang diri dan jauh dari rumah, tanpa makanan.
keg: Ketika lapar, tiada pekerjaan, atau menunggu rezeki yang tidak dapat diatur sendiri.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-Qasas. Musa telah lari dari Mesir, memberi minum ternakan dua orang wanita yang tidak dapat sampai ke perigi, lalu duduk di tempat teduh dan berdoa.
art: No person in frame. An old stone well in a dry desert valley at the edge of a small town, water troughs beside it, a flock of sheep drinking. A single acacia tree throws a small pool of shade on the sand, empty, as if someone has just sat there.

pen: Dress well for the place of prayer, eat and drink, and do not overdo it.
ken: A line for the table: before a feast, a buffet, or an iftar spread.
aen: From Surah Al-A'raf, addressed to all the children of Adam: dignity at the masjid and moderation at the table.
p: Berpakaian elok ke tempat ibadat, makan dan minumlah, dan jangan berlebihan.
keg: Satu baris untuk meja makan: sebelum kenduri, bufet, atau hidangan berbuka.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-A'raf, ditujukan kepada semua anak Adam: maruah di masjid dan bersederhana di meja makan.
art: A kenduri in a kampung house after Friday prayers. A boy in a clean baju Melayu and songkok stands at a long low table crowded with dishes of nasi, rendang and kuih, holding a modest plate with a small portion. Guests in the background, a fan turning overhead.
tr: yābanī ādama khudhū zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulū wa-ish'rabū walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīna
en: O children of Adam, take your adornment [i.e., wear your clothing] at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.
my: Wahai anak-anak Adam! Pakailah pakaian kamu yang indah berhias pada tiap-tiap kali kamu ke tempat ibadat (atau mengerjakan sembahyang), dan makanlah serta minumlah, dan jangan pula kamu melampau; sesungguhnya Allah tidak suka akan orang-orang yang melampaui batas.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih

ten: Eat From the Good, and Be Grateful
pen: Eat from the good things Allah has provided, and thank Him for them.
ken: Before a meal, or when a plate of food is a reminder of how much is given.
aen: From Surah Al-Baqarah, in the passage on lawful food. Eating well and giving thanks are named in the same breath.
p: Makanlah daripada yang baik yang telah Allah rezekikan, dan bersyukurlah kepadaNya.
keg: Sebelum makan, atau ketika sepinggan makanan mengingatkan betapa banyak yang diberi.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-Baqarah, dalam bahagian tentang makanan yang halal. Makan dengan baik dan bersyukur disebut bersama.
art: Dinner on the floor of a wooden kampung house. A small family sits on a mat around rice, a bowl of gulai and a jug of water, hands raised in dua before eating. A kerosene lamp, rain at the window, a cat curled by the door.
tr: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wa-ush'kurū lillahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna
en: O you who have believed, eat from the good [i.e., lawful] things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allāh if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.
my: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman! Makanlah dari benda-benda yang baik (yang halal) yang telah Kami berikan kepada kamu, dan bersyukurlah kepada Allah, jika betul kamu hanya beribadat kepadanya.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih

pen: Said to the messengers: eat from what is good and lawful, and do righteous work.
ken: For a meal earned honestly, or a reminder that what we eat and what we do belong together.
aen: From Surah Al-Mu'minun, addressed to the messengers themselves, joining what they eat with how they act.
t: Makanan Yang Baik dan Amal Yang Soleh
p: Dikatakan kepada para Rasul: makanlah yang baik lagi halal, dan kerjakanlah amal soleh.
keg: Untuk hidangan yang diperoleh dengan jujur, atau peringatan bahawa apa yang dimakan dan apa yang dilakukan saling berkait.
asb: Daripada Surah Al-Mu'minun, ditujukan kepada para Rasul sendiri, menghubungkan apa yang mereka makan dengan cara mereka beramal.
art: A pasar pagi at dawn. A mother in tudung sets out trays of kuih at her stall under a canvas awning, her young son carefully arranging banana leaves beside her. Lamps still lit, wet road, the first customers arriving.
tr: yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun
en: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
my: Wahai Rasul-rasul, makanlah dari benda-benda yang baik lagi halal dan kerjakanlah amal-amal soleh; sesungguhnya Aku Maha Mengetahui akan apa yang kamu kerjakan.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
